name: Later Daters
source:
Old souls of the world, this is your time to shine – and potentially get a little action in the romance department!

You’re the newest resident at Ye OLDE retirement community, where you’ll meet a cast of sexy seniors who are all dying (not literally) to meet you. It’s a lot like summer camp, but with orthopedic shoes, bridge clubs, and more jell-o. It’s an adjustment as you settle in, but who knows: maybe these will turn out to be the best years of your life!

[From [url=https://laterdatersgame.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
世界上的老灵魂们，这是你们闪耀的时刻——并且有可能在浪漫方面有所行动！

你是Ye OLDE退休社区的最新居民，在那里你会遇到一群性感的老年人，他们都渴望见到你（不是字面上的意思）。这很像夏令营，但有矫形鞋、桥牌俱乐部和更多果冻。这是你安顿下来后的一种调整，但谁知道呢：也许这将是你一生中最美好的时光！

[来自[url=https://laterdatersgame.com/]官网[/url]]
